errors.CANNOT_REVOKE_LAST_ADMIN_INVITE: This is the last pending administrator invitation and the organization has no active administrator, so it cannot be revoked. Send another administrator invitation first.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_IN_ORGANIZATION: That email address is already in your organization, either as a member or as a pending invitation.
errors.EMAIL_BELONGS_TO_ANOTHER_ORGANIZA: That email address belongs to a member of another organization, so it cannot be invited here.
errors.ORGANIZATION_HAS_CHILDREN: This organization has sub-organizations. Reassign or remove the children first.
errors.ORGANIZATION_HAS_CHILDREN.has_chi: This organization has sub-organizations, so it cannot be deleted. Reassign or delete them first.
errors.ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED: This organization is not active, so orders cannot be placed. Contact your sales representative to have it reactivated.
errors.ORGANIZATION_TAX_ID_EXISTS: An organization with this tax ID is already registered. Sign in instead, or ask its administrator to invite you.
errors.ORGANIZATION_TREE_INVALID: The requested organization move is invalid (it would create a cycle or exceed the maximum depth).
errors.ORGANIZATION_TREE_INVALID.cycle: The chosen parent is inside this organization's own subtree, so the move would create a cycle. Pick a parent outside it.
errors.ORGANIZATION_TREE_INVALID.max_dep: The move would take the organization tree past its maximum depth of {maxDepth} levels. Move the branch higher up, or flatten part of it first.
errors.ORGANIZATION_TREE_INVALID.path_un: The stored tree position of organization {organizationId} cannot be read, so it cannot be moved or chosen as a parent. This is a fault in that organization's record rather than in your choice; ask an administrator to repair it.
errors.ORG_OWNER_DEPLETION: This account is the organization's last active administrator, so it cannot be deleted, blocked or moved out. Give the administrator role to another member first.
